source_reference: Approved Roshan identity/atlas; owner-selected Laura for acting language. No quantitative Laura stroke measurement claimed.

poses.action: Tail base gathers; distal tail and fluke lag. Keep gaze ahead and shoulders quiet.
poses.needed_surface: Waist-to-tail continuous volume, folded inner curve and trailing fluke face.

poses.action: Flexion travels from waist through tail to fluke; the broad fin sweeps against water, then acceleration follows.
poses.needed_surface: Broad contact surface and fluke underside/edge, tail compression without shrinking or stretching painted anatomy.

poses.action: Tail lengthens behind the body; chest follows the impulse while head stays readable.
poses.needed_surface: Complete extended tail silhouette and changing inner/outer painted surfaces.

poses.action: Continue along the stroke direction while speed falls. Arms and shoulders do not paddle; fin feathers.
poses.needed_surface: Relaxed side-swim body, low-drag fluke angle and authored hair lag.

poses.action: Recover through the opposite curvature; fin changes pitch through an edge view before the next stroke.
poses.needed_surface: Recovery curvature, fluke reversal edge/underside and matching intermediate surfaces.

poses.action: Tail/fin oppose remaining travel once, then resolve to supported rest.
poses.needed_surface: Braking fin face, tail counterbalance, hair settle and a true quiet endpoint.

poses.action: Gather, rotate through actual quarter/front/quarter surfaces and open into the opposite swim direction.
poses.needed_surface: Near/far face, shoulders, arms, hair and fin occlusion; no flip, squeeze or route-only reversal.

poses.action: Raise through soft elbow to an open palm, wave once, lower and settle while tail supports the pose.
poses.needed_surface: New-view shoulder/elbow coverage, open palm/fingers and targeted gaze.

next_method: Author/establish whole-figure load, push, extension, recovery and fin-reversal keys before another full-sequence trial. Repair/register view binding under shared-contract ownership. Existing source can inform identity, not replace new surfaces.
blocking_review: Exact new keys and transitions need visual/identity/topology/style review. No funded API job, generation readiness or delivery acceptance is claimed.
